items.title: Father cannot afford last rites for son missing in Bhotekoshi floods
items.blurb: Forty-seven days after 25-year-old Pradip Sapkota went missing, his family has yet to recover his body and is struggling to pay for his funeral rites.

items.title: Makawanpur begins process to declare 58 missing people dead
items.blurb: Authorities have begun verifying the status of those missing since the August 26 Bhotekoshi floods under a special government procedure, with local units required to collect applications and check claims.

items.title: India boat capsizes, drowning 13, mostly children
items.blurb: Police are ​investigating the ​cause of the incident, regional police ​officer Subodh Kumar ​told Reuters on Wednesday, giving the tally of those ​rescued.

items.title: Relief helicopter gives Rasuwa farmers a route to market
items.blurb: The WFP has flown around eight tonnes of vegetables from flood-isolated Aamachhodingmo to Bidur, helping growers salvage part of their harvest.

items.title: Salyan villages have little heart for Dashain celebrations
items.blurb: Dozens remain missing after the Bhotekoshi floods in Rasuwa, leaving families and neighbours across the district with little to celebrate this year.

items.title: Flood cuts off northern Gorkha’s lifeline, disrupts Manaslu trekking season
items.blurb: Five bridges and key roads and trails have been washed away, damaging tourism businesses and leaving trekkers stranded.

items.title: What it means to live with the disaster paradox
items.blurb: Recurring disasters in Nepal destroy crops, permanently erode farmland, displace families and worsen economic inequality.

items.title: Escalating catastrophes, mounting health crisis
items.blurb: The government must immediately secure clean water, enforce emergency sanitation and monitor emerging infections.

items.title: Flood-displaced Rasuwa students resume classes in Lalitpur
items.blurb: Hakubesi Basic School from Amachhodingmo Rural Municipality is now operating from the premises of Kitini Secondary School in Godawari.

items.title: Eleven sailors missing after drone sinks ship off Bulgaria
items.blurb: Bulgaria stopped short of explicitly accusing Russia of carrying out the attacks but Prime Minister Rumen Radev said their outcome“benefits the Russian Federation”.

items.title: Nepal, India discuss border security, transnational crime and disaster response
items.blurb: The two neighbours also seek closer coordination on disaster preparedness as floods and landslides threaten border communities, transport links and infrastructure.

items.title: Bailey bridge planned at flood-damaged Arughat crossing
items.blurb: A 22-metre section of the bridge was washed away by the Budhi Gandaki flood on Sunday, halting traffic between Gorkha and Dhading. Authorities aim to complete the temporary crossing within 10 days.

items.title: 14 internet providers fined for overcharging customers
items.blurb: The Nepal Telecommunications Authority has fined the companies Rs50,000 each, ordered the withdrawal of unauthorised packages and directed compensation for customers who suffered losses.
